selection.rule: Lowest mean RF calls among candidates passing EVERY frontend x condition x case against current_periodic. No extra CRC-accepted wrong words in any cell. Descriptive DEV tolerances, not formal noninferiority. No tuning after validation.

rs.packet_phase: Uniform 0..2039 symbols independently per stream; same for all methods

receiver.refinement: Per-block RMS >2*block median, restricted to legacy symbol flags; erase codeword byte iff >=2 flags; original byte grid
receiver.confirm8: After changed action, confidence<0.75, or an armed change event, request the next two block-end decisions; every call charged
receiver.rule: Persistent fast ALE; block energy-ratio gate >0.25; relative pulse masking; no classifier
receiver.state: Reset only between independent streams; never at packets or jammer transitions
receiver.timing: All outputs wait until the current 5 ms block ends. current policies may route that buffered block after observing it. lag controls apply the prior block decision. Neither reads later blocks.

limitations: Simulation, BPSK, ideal symbol/codeword synchronization; not a complete RF link
No hardware energy or deployment assertion
Block-median refinement buffers up to 5 ms; codewords need 20.4 ms assembly plus remaining block time
Feature and duplicate decoder work shared by harness; timing is not per-device energy
DEV tolerances are selection rules, not a formal noninferiority test
V3 observed panel excluded from selection and test; new namespace and training seeds
This is a new development pilot; v4 has been observed. New seed namespaces do not make the generator a new physical domain.
Risk thresholds chosen before local pilot; no data-driven threshold sweep.
ALE state updates during rescue are charged even if residual output is rejected.
Mixed-jammer and waveform diversity remain limited to this simulator.

rescue.trigger_reference: Immediately preceding received block; no labels, packet locations or CRC outcomes
rescue.action: Risk window forces a current-block RF refresh in guard8 variants. rescue variants run the single persistent ALE fast, accepting its output iff rho > 0.25; otherwise raw block. State is retained even when output rejected. No parallel ALE branch.
